terms.comment: Our formation, after Morgan–Owens’s pinna natātōria for a flipper; armilla, a bracelet, is classical.

phrases.latin: Armillās natātōriās indue, deinde in aquam dēscende.
phrases.english: Put your armbands on, then get into the water.

sources: Lewis & Short: armilla · Lewis & Short: natatorius
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. swimming; swimming: life jacket, swimming float, swimfin; swimsuit. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): pp. 50, 389.
